task:
Implement the core PLAYER ACTION rewrite for Maples using only Game.js and Character.js. Return ONLY a canonical unified diff. No new files and no prose. Preserve unrelated encounter/HUD/world/camera behavior and the existing public Character interfaces consumed by Rowan animation/polish code.

Architecture: Character must be the authoritative source for Rowan action state and action timing; Game must resolve world consequences. Remove/reduce duplicate attack/combo timing authority in Game without introducing a new controller. Preserve state, stateTime, stateDuration, comboIndex, dead, invuln, speed, facing, position, beginAttack, beginDodge, takeDamage, update, and attackWindow (or an exactly compatible one-shot hit query).

Combat feel requirements: reliable ~180ms attack input buffering; crisp 3-hit chain with distinct timing and clean reset/continuation; exactly one active hit event per swing; stronger committed finisher; combo-specific controlled forward movement; avoid active-frame 180-degree retargeting; late-recovery dodge cancel where fair; explicit dodge i-frames and commitment; spell keeps mana/cooldown contracts and deliberate cast state; cooldown/input semantics that should be real-time must not slow down because hit-stop scales world dt.

Use existing Game FX/audio/camera hooks for real-hit feedback only. Tier hit-stop/shake/kick by combo, preserve current damage/range balance unless small tuning improves feel, and keep boss/encounter/XP/loot/HUD/spawn/collision behavior intact. Do not change Enemy.js. Keep mobile simultaneous movement+actions and desktop input contracts compatible. Prefer a focused patch over broad cleanup.
